title: Ablation study at 100-SKU scale (10 seeds). Total cost normalized to BL1 per seed. p-value is Holm-corrected paired t-test of each variant vs full AAIRM (Variant D).

A.label: A (RL-only)
A.description: PPO Reorder Optimization Agent with deterministic rule-based orchestrator; governance (C5) disabled; supplier selection fixed lowest-cost.

B.label: B (Gov.-only)
B.description: Governance (C5) and supplier ranking (C3) with LLM orchestrator; RL policy replaced by classical ROP-EOQ.

C.label: C (No-LLM)
C.description: Full pipeline with RL ordering and governance; LLM orchestrator replaced by deterministic rule-based task router.

D.label: D (Full AAIRM)
D.description: Complete system; identical to Table tab:results-overview.

llm_null_result.conclusion: practical equivalence: LLM orchestrator adds no economically meaningful value in structured procurement
